userStories.title: Add safe_get_config_value utility to eliminate scattered dict/object dual-access
acceptanceCriteria: Create safe_get_config_value(obj, key, default=None) function in src/config/utils.py that handles both dict .get() and dataclass getattr() access patterns
Function returns obj.get(key, default) when obj is a dict, and getattr(obj, key, default) when obj is a dataclass or object
Replace at least 5 scattered isinstance(x, dict)/getattr patterns in src/config/base.py with calls to safe_get_config_value
Replace dict/object dual-access patterns in src/cli/config_utils.py with calls to safe_get_config_value
Add unit tests in tests/test_config.py verifying safe_get_config_value works for dict input, dataclass input, and missing key with default

Duration tiers are in src/config/sections/duration.py, matching thresholds in src/config/sections/matching.py (lines ~175-180), output fields in src/config/sections/output.py (~line 120). Sprint 44 US-44-003 already added pipeline-level validation; this expands the Config-level validate().

userStories.title: Re-validate config sections after CLI merge overrides are applied
acceptanceCriteria: After merge_config() in src/cli/config_utils.py applies all overrides, __post_init__() is called on each modified config section that has one
Duration tier merges trigger DurationTiersConfig.__post_init__() to re-validate min <= max constraints
Healing config merges trigger HealingConfig.__post_init__() to re-convert nested dicts
Add test that merges an invalid duration tier override (min > max) and verifies the post-merge validation catches it
Existing merge behavior is preserved for valid overrides (no regressions in config loading)
userStories.notes: Added _revalidate_modified_sections() that calls __post_init__() on each modified section after merge. Extended DurationTiersConfig.__post_init__() to validate min/max on existing DurationTierConfig instances (not just dicts). Added 6 tests in TestPostMergeRevalidation: invalid duration tier warning, healing dict conversion (watcher + llm_healer), valid override preservation, unmodified section preservation, legacy path revalidation. All 50 config merge tests pass.

userStories.title: Unify path resolution between base.py and cli/config_utils.py into single implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Path resolution logic exists in exactly one location (src/config/base.py _resolve_paths or a new shared function)
src/cli/config_utils.py make_paths_project_relative() delegates to the shared path resolution instead of reimplementing
Project-relative paths are only resolved once during config loading (no double-resolution)
Paths containing forward slashes, backslashes, and mixed separators all resolve correctly on Windows
Add test that loads config with relative paths and verifies they resolve to absolute project-relative paths exactly once
userStories.notes: Unified path resolution: (1) Config._resolve_paths() in base.py is the single source of truth for all path resolution. (2) make_paths_project_relative() delegates to _resolve_paths() - no reimplementation. (3) load_project_config() now delegates to make_paths_project_relative() instead of duplicating its logic (removed 4 duplicated lines). (4) _resolve_paths() uses pathlib which normalizes mixed separators. (5) Added 5 new tests: forward-slash, backslash, no-double-resolution, load_project_config delegation, plus existing mixed-separator and exact-once tests. All 36 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add MatchingConfig __post_init__ validation for confidence threshold ranges
acceptanceCriteria: MatchingConfig in src/config/sections/matching.py has a __post_init__ method that validates all float confidence fields are in range 0.0-1.0
Fields validated include: min_confidence, high_confidence_threshold, low_confidence_threshold, ambiguous_threshold, skip_llm_threshold, confidence_threshold
Out-of-range values are clamped to 0.0-1.0 with a logger.warning message (consistent with IterativeMatchingConfig pattern)
Integer fields (max_videos_per_segment, max_results, min_results) are validated as positive with logger.warning if <= 0
Add test constructing MatchingConfig with out-of-range confidence (e.g., 1.5) and verify it is clamped to 1.0
userStories.notes: Tier: T2 (validation). Source file: src/config/sections/matching.py. MatchingConfig has 50+ fields but NO __post_init__ validation. Follow clamping pattern from IterativeMatchingConfig.__post_init__ in src/config/sections/iterative_matching.py (lines ~95-107). The existing __post_init__ in matching.py only handles nested dataclass conversion for location_matching, chapter_detection, scoring - it does not validate numeric ranges.
